Lemma
[Heat-adjoint symmetry on a noncompact manifold] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0363 ↗ lem:chow-iii-dirichlet-heat-adjoint-symmetry ↗ thm:chow-iii-noncompact-evolving-heat-kernel 1. ch26:26.13\group Noncompact Heat Kernels

For the minimal positive fundamental solution on a complete noncompact manifold, \[ H(x,\tau ;y,v)=H^*(y,v;x,\tau ). \] Thus the second variables satisfy the adjoint equation and terminal delta condition.
